task.name: four-pair associative recall
task.input_layout: [BOS, key_0, value_0, key_1, value_1, key_2, value_2, key_3, value_3, QUERY, query_key]
task.unused_vocabulary_token_ids: All other IDs in [0, vocab_size) are unused as inputs and remain in the full-vocabulary output softmax.
task.secondary_accuracy: top-1 restricted to the eight value token IDs

example_generation.description: For each namespace, seed, example_index, nonce, pool_name, and candidate token ID, rank candidate IDs by the pair (SHA-256 digest bytes, candidate token ID) computed from the UTF-8 string 'S06-DP-001|v1|{namespace}|{seed}|{example_index}|{nonce}|{pool_name}|{candidate_id}'. Use the first four ranked key IDs and the first four ranked value IDs in their ranked order. Set target_slot=example_index mod 4. Build tokens using input_layout and target the value at target_slot. Generate indices in ascending order. If an 11-token input sequence identity already exists in any train or evaluation split, increment nonce and regenerate that example. The evaluation split is generated once from namespace='evaluation' and evaluation_seed; training splits use namespace='training' and their respective seed.
example_generation.identity: SHA-256 of the 11 token IDs encoded as unsigned 16-bit little-endian integers

task.sequence_identity_policy: Require all training input sequences to be unique and disjoint across seeds; require the shared evaluation inputs to be unique and absent from all training inputs.

training.minibatch_order: ascending example_index; 32 consecutive examples per update, keeping eight examples per target_slot in every batch

compute_budget.estimates_exclude: feature-map, scalar, Python-loop, optimizer, and autograd-intermediate overhead; these are analytical estimates, not measured FLOPs

decision_rule.if_any_condition_fails: Mark the screen failed or incomplete, preserve every run record, and do not retune or proceed to architecture-comparison training.

scope: Synthetic algorithmic training-stability and retrieval screen for this RoPE-before-ELU-plus-one reference only; distance and later-distractor count form joint strata and cannot be interpreted as independent effects. No architecture control, capability claim, corpus training, or generalization claim.
